main.description: Get a private-tier post thread. Requires auth by a ready community member. At most 200 nodes (anchor, parents and replies); unauthorized or missing children and parents are omitted, and the parent chain stops at the first missed parent. Audiences this AppView resolves: `list` (the audience record's members); `followers` (followers of the audience's owner who are ready members of this AppView, by the follow records it has indexed, which reflect a new follow or an unfollow within about a minute); `everyone` (every ready member of this AppView, not the network); and `nobody`. `following`: the accounts the audience's owner follows that are ready members of this AppView, by the follow records it has indexed, once it has compared them with the owner's repository. Until then, and always for an owner that follows more than 50 000 accounts, a `following` audience is read by its owner alone, and replies under it by their authors alone. An unfollow stops reads within about a minute. A `following` post appears in a reader's timeline only when the reader also follows its owner. When neither the owner nor a replier is a ready member, and this AppView is not indexing public records, the owner's follow of the replier is not indexed, so that reply is read by its author alone. Any other mode is served to its author only. A block record or a private block between the reader and the author, or the audience's owner, in either direction, keeps the reader out; a block through a list does not. A post under another account's audience, on any PDS, is served to anyone but its author only when one of its 8 nearest ancestors, walked through stored private posts under the same audience that the reader could read, is that account's post; its author may write there (`list` or no mode: listed in `members`; `followers`: a stored follow of that account; `everyone`: always; `following`: that account's indexed follow of the author, once compared with its repository as above; any other mode: never); in every mode, neither its author nor that account blocks the other; and that account is active. A reply more than 8 levels below that account's nearest post is served to its author only.

depth.description: How many levels of replies to include.

parentHeight.description: How many levels of parent posts to include.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: Post not found. Returned identically whether the anchor does not exist or is not visible to the requester.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

errors.description: The caller's account indexing is still in progress.
